newsitem.title: CANADA: Royal Bank Canada boosts small business plan.
newsitem.headline: Royal Bank Canada boosts small business plan.

text.p: Royal Bank of Canada said on Wednesday that it will commit an additional C$200 million in growth financing for small and medium-sized companies.
The investment raises the total amount of risk capital within the bank's venture capital subsidiary, Royal Bank Capital Corp, to C$350 million.

"The additional capital we're putting into the company underscores in a very tangible way our commitment to lead the way in providing our business clients with the broadest range of financing options," Royal Bank chairman and chief executive officer John Cleghorn said in a statement.
